# The correct mapping based on the bulletin years:
# Treasury Bulletin 1980-11 page shows Nov. = November 1979
# Treasury Bulletin 1981-11 page shows Nov. = November 1980
# Treasury Bulletin 1982-11 page shows Nov. = November 1981

# November 1979 (from 1980 bulletin): Total = 1,574, Interest = 7
# November 1980 (from 1981 bulletin): Total = 1,938, Interest = 10
# November 1981 (from 1982 bulletin): Total = 2,608, Interest = 5

total_1979 = 1574
interest_1979 = 7

total_1980 = 1938
interest_1980 = 10

total_1981 = 2608
interest_1981 = 5

print("="*50)

print(f"November 1980: Total receipts = {total_1980}, Interest = {interest_1980}")
print(f"November 1981: Total receipts = {total_1981}, Interest = {interest_1981}")

# Calculate ratios

ratio_1980 = interest_1980 / total_1980
ratio_1981 = interest_1981 / total_1981

print("\n" + "="*50)
print("Ratios (Interest / Total receipts):")
print("="*50)
print(f"November 1979: {ratio_1979:.10f}")
print(f"November 1980: {ratio_1980:.10f}")
print(f"November 1981: {ratio_1981:.10f}")

# Find highest and lowest ratios
highest = max(ratio_1979, ratio_1980, ratio_1981)
lowest = min(ratio_1979, ratio_1980, ratio_1981)

print("\n" + "="*50)
print(f"Highest ratio: {highest:.10f}")
print(f"Lowest ratio: {lowest:.10f}")

# Absolute difference
diff = highest - lowest
print(f"\nAbsolute difference: {diff:.10f}")

# Round to 5 decimal places
rounded = round(diff, 5)
print(f"\nRounded to 5 decimal places: {rounded}")

# Check if need more precision for trailing zeros
print(f"\nFormatted without trailing zeros: {rounded}")
EOF
